title: Gaussian Boundary Inference in a Hypergeometric Heavy-Tailed Family
abstract: arXiv:2609.20393v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper develops inference for a Gaussian-nested hypergeometric family of distribution functions. The family \[ G_c(z) = \frac12 + z\,\frac{\Gamma(c-1/2)}{2\sqrt2\,\Gamma(c)}\,{}_1F_1\!\left(\frac12;c;-\frac{z^2}{2}\right),\quad c\ge\frac32, \] contains the standard normal distribution at the boundary $c=3/2$. Away from the boundary, the density has algebraic tail behaviour $g_c(z)\sim(c-3/2)|z|^{-3}$, so the parameter $c$ indexes a directed heavy-tailed deformation of the Gaussian law. The distribution also admits an equivalent beta-precision normal scale-mixture representation, in which the Gaussian boundary corresponds to degenerate unit precision. I establish the admissibility of the hypergeometric family, derive minimum-distance estimators, and obtain both regular interior asymptotics and nonstandard boundary asymptotics under the normal null. The standardised fit-improvement statistic converges to the mixture distribution $\tf

translated_title: 超几何重尾分布族中的高斯边界推断
translated_abstract: 本文针对一类以高斯分布为嵌套边界的超几何分布函数族发展了统计推断方法。该分布族 G_c(z) = 1/2 + z·Γ(c-1/2)/(2√2·Γ(c))·₁F₁(1/2; c; -z²/2)（其中 c≥3/2）在边界 c=3/2 处包含标准正态分布。在远离边界处，密度呈现代数型尾部行为 g_c(z)~(c-3/2)|z|⁻³，因此参数 c 刻画了高斯分布的一种有向重尾变形。该分布还具有等价的 beta-精度正态尺度混合表示，其中高斯边界对应于退化的单位精度。作者建立了该超几何分布族的容许性，推导了最小距离估计量，并在正态原假设下同时获得了常规的内部渐近性质与非标准的边界渐近性质。标准化拟合改进统计量收敛于一个混合分布……
tldr: 本文提出了一类在边界处退化为标准正态分布、远离边界时呈代数重尾的超几何分布族，建立了其容许性与最小距离估计方法，并推导出正态原假设下边界处的非标准渐近理论，用于高斯分布的边界推断。
en_tdlr: This paper develops inference for a hypergeometric heavy-tailed family that nests the standard normal at its boundary, establishing admissibility, minimum-distance estimation, and nonstandard boundary asymptotics under the normal null.
